source_title: BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook: Fitness Trainers and Instructors
observation: BLS reports 370,100 fitness trainer and instructor jobs in 2024, 14% self-employed, and 12% projected growth from 2024 to 2034.
limitations: Occupation is broader than independent online-hybrid coaches.
Employment is not the paid app-user count.

observation: Trainerize reports 223,600 new programs, 11.25M completed habits, 3.86M appointments and 516,000 Apple Watch connections on its platform, indicating repeated coaching workflow activity.
denominator: not publicly provided by the vendor report
limitations: Vendor-selected global platform data.
No coach or client denominator.
Not proof of triage pain, payment or retention for this idea.

observation: Everfit lists Pro at $19 per month for 5 clients and $49 per month for 20 clients, showing a paid recurring coaching-software budget.
unit: USD per month starting paid list price
limitations: List price is not transaction or retention evidence.
Does not prove willingness to pay for an additional triage layer.
Billing is not necessarily Apple IAP.

observation: RevenueCat reports Health and Fitness median D60 RPI of $0.66 and Business median D60 RPI of $0.50; North American subscription projects are strongly App-Store-skewed.
unit: USD median D60 RPI, Health and Fitness
denominator: RevenueCat-integrated subscription apps included in the 2026 report
limitations: Not coach-side SaaS or US+iOS-only.
SDK-selected subscription-app population.
Not first-party economics.

source_title: Everfit for Coach US App Store recent review feed
observation: Reviewed comments report lost program edits after crashes, stuck messaging and short voice-note limits without transcription, plus client sync and rescheduling restrictions.
denominator: three inspected recent reviews from a listing with 168 ratings
limitations: Self-selected examples, not prevalence.
Review statements were not independently verified.
The proposed triage overlay was not tested.

observation: My PT Hub already sells an AI Check-Ins add-on for $12 per month, directly constraining a generic AI check-in wedge.
unit: USD per month add-on list price
limitations: Existing feature does not prove it solves prioritization or coach trust.
No observed switching behavior.

source_title: Apple App Review Guidelines: health, privacy and physical harm
observation: Apple permits health and fitness apps but applies extra scrutiny to inaccurate medical information, physical-harm risks and health-data privacy; explicit permission is required for third-party AI sharing.
limitations: Clear only for a coach-approved, non-medical, HealthKit-free first scope.
Guidelines can change and do not assure approval.

source_title: FTC Health Breach Notification Rule: Basics for Business
observation: FTC guidance states that the Health Breach Notification Rule can apply to many health apps and connected technologies, requiring a breach-response path for covered health information.
limitations: Scope depends on exact data flows and legal interpretation.
This is not legal advice.

observation: Public employment data does not isolate US independent hybrid coaches with 10-40 active clients, iPhones and a paid coaching platform.
limitations: Only the broader trainer and instructor occupation is observable.
